deltaConvention: positive featureVsMain values mean feature is slower or allocates more
comparisonCaveat: The logical fixtures match, but each branch measures its native wire contract: main legacy-v3 versus feature strict-v4. Deltas are end-to-end migration outcomes, not same-byte codec microbenchmarks; strict-v4 validation and canonical re-encoding are intentionally included. Payload bytes and SHA-256 values are outcomes, not inputs.
